Bubble uses your phone\'s wireless debugging to build and protect the bubble, without root. You pair it once with a code; after that Bubble turns debugging on only while it works.

1. Turn on Developer options: Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times.\n2. In Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging and open «Pair device with pairing code».\n3. Tap Pair here, pull down the notification shade and type the 6-digit code into Bubble\'s notification.
Now open «Pair device with pairing code» in Wireless debugging, pull down the notification shade and type the code into Bubble\'s notification. Then come back here.
The bubble is a private space without Google, separate from the rest of the phone. It comes with F-Droid to install apps and a keyboard with no internet access. It takes about a minute.
Open the app drawer and unlock the Private section at the bottom to enter. Add apps from Bubble or install them with F-Droid inside.

Apps start inside with no data, without Google services and without internet: tap the Wi-Fi or mobile data icon to turn them on. Apps copied from the phone keep being updated by Play while they stay installed outside.

The guard is watching the bubble all the time: if Google services appear inside, it disables them within a minute.

The guard checks the bubble every time Bubble opens, does something or the phone starts. It cannot stay running because USB debugging is off; with everything off, no one else can put Google services in the bubble either.
The guard is not running. Open Bubble to start it again.
For Facebook and Instagram, outside the bubble
Could not check the Meta space now
There is no Meta space yet
Facebook and Instagram close by themselves inside the bubble. The Meta space is a separate place where they work.

Why: Facebook and Instagram look for Google when they start and close if they do not find it. The bubble has no Google, so they do not work there.

What it is: a space apart from the bubble, in the Work tab of the app drawer. Google is installed there but turned off: the apps find it and work, without notifications, and Google does not run.

What you gain: Facebook and Instagram cannot see your contacts, photos or the rest of the phone, and the bubble stays free of Google.

What you accept: Android lets Google be turned back on from Settings. If that happens the guard turns it off, but meanwhile it would see this space's apps, never the bubble. The phone's Google knows this space exists and which apps it has.

You can delete it any time without touching the bubble.

The phone is as it was before Bubble. You can uninstall Bubble now.\n\nTo remove the pairing too: Settings → System → Developer options → Revoke debugging authorizations.
Apps in this space have no internet
The firewall could not get the list of apps with internet, so to be safe none has network. Open Bubble to send it again.

If an app in the bubble asks for your fingerprint (a bank, for example), give the bubble its own lock: in Settings → Private space → Private space lock, choose a PIN and add your fingerprint. Do it with the bubble open.
